account.add.description: Create a Claude or Codex account home, configure and test a model endpoint, or add an executor for a provider OpenCode is signed in to (source: opencode).

account.adopt.description: Adopt an external OpenCode provider's URL and model ids, supplying a new key source.

account.edit.description: Edit a managed endpoint and regenerate its OpenCode provider.

account.list.description: Accounts, usage and sign-in commands without account emails.

account.models.description: Discover endpoint models using a supplied or stored key.

account.remove.description: Remove an unused account, optionally deleting its protected-path-checked home.

account.signin.description: Open the account login in an available terminal, or return its command.

account.test.description: Run an endpoint test task in an isolated temporary git repository.

account.usage.check.description: Check usage for an account independently of its planner or executor role. Claude requires explicit consent for a quota-consuming small task; poll job.get for progress and observation outcome.

activity.list.description: Activity log, newest first, with optional repo, kind and task filters.

agent.connect.description: Connect an agent after explicit consent to write its integration files.

agent.detect.description: Detect installed agent CLIs and their versions.

agent.disconnect.description: Remove an agent integration using its recorded undo actions.

agent.preview.description: Preview agent integration files and the undo command before consenting.

api.describe.description: Describe one operation and its JSON parameter schema; semantic validation also runs when called.

api.list.description: Discover operations by optional name prefix and case-insensitive name/description search; parameter schemas are omitted.

assistant.ask.description: Ask the assistant one question. The answer streams from /v3/assistant/turns/<turnId>/stream; nothing runs until the user confirms a proposed action.

assistant.cancel.description: Cancel a turn that is still being answered.

assistant.candidates.description: Endpoint accounts the assistant could run on, and what it is allowed to read.

assistant.card.record.description: Record the user's decision and the outcome on an action card in the conversation. The app runs the proposed op itself.

assistant.card.refresh.description: Rebuild a card whose task changed, with the task's current revision.

assistant.conversation.description: The turns of one conversation, with action cards and their outcomes.

assistant.conversations.description: A page of assistant conversations, newest first.

assistant.delete.description: Delete one conversation, or every conversation without an id. Usage figures stay, without the text.

assistant.settings.get.description: The assistant's account, limits and retention, with a revision for assistant.settings.set.

assistant.settings.set.description: Choose the executor account the assistant runs on, and its limits and retention. Needs the current revision.

assistant.status.description: Whether the assistant is available, which account answers, why not when it is not, its limits and today's use.

assistant.turn.description: One turn, for reading its final state after a stream ends.

client.control.claim.description: Page worker polls for an action; renews its 60-second lease. Worker credential must remain private.

client.control.complete.description: Page worker acknowledges an applied action or a bounded failure code.

client.control.enroll.description: Enroll a connected app-page control worker; ephemeral credential is used only by that page. Does not grant native update authority.

client.control.request.description: Request an allowlisted action on an explicit connected client; navigation requires a main target to preserve its form guard. Poll client.control.result; pending is not success. Native quit may disconnect before acknowledgment, leaving an unknown outcome.

client.control.result.description: Read client action status and acknowledgment; timeout is failed, never successful.

client.control.targets.description: List connected page targets for appearance, navigation and native window controls. Select an explicit client_id.

client.heartbeat.description: Renew a client lease, which lapses after 45 seconds without a heartbeat.

client.register.description: Register a client with an optional notifier lease; heartbeat every 30 seconds. Desktop clients may opt into capture to receive an ephemeral instance credential.

config.get.description: Allow-listed settings with their sources and compatible planner candidates.

config.set.description: Change a setting with validation, rollback and an undo command; planner requires an integration choice.

delegation.pause.description: Pause new delegation for up to seven days.

desktop.capture.claim.description: Claim the next capture for the authenticated desktop worker; worker credential comes from client.register capture=true.

desktop.capture.complete.description: Report a failed capture. Successful PNG bytes use the bounded authenticated image upload route.

desktop.capture.register.description: Renew a capture worker credential for an existing connected desktop instance after expiry or recovery.

desktop.capture.request.description: Request a capture of an owned desktop main or tray window; poll desktop.capture.result.

desktop.capture.result.description: Read capture status/metadata; completed PNG is at /v3/desktop/capture/<request_id>/image with normal authentication.

desktop.capture.targets.description: List owned windows reported by connected authenticated desktop capture workers.

desktop.reconcile.cancel.description: Cancel reconciliation; unavailable until reconciliation is implemented.

desktop.reconcile.request.description: Request reconciliation of an inspected candidate; unavailable until native proof and implementation exist.

desktop.reconcile.status.description: Read bounded service reconciliation assessment; claims do not constitute native proof.

desktop.update.adopt.description: Explicitly transfer the inspected attached service registration to this desktop bundled CLI when idle.

desktop.update.adoptCancel.description: Cancel a waiting service adoption using its adoption revision before reservation.

desktop.update.cancel.description: Cancel a desktop check, download or waiting restart before reservation.

desktop.update.check.description: Check the verified desktop release feed, bypassing the cached check; update-check opt-outs still apply.

desktop.update.configure.description: Set automatic desktop downloads without granting restart permission.

desktop.update.download.description: Download and verify the offered complete desktop release.

desktop.update.restart.description: Request restart into the displayed desktop version/revision when idle; permission expires with the verified desktop session.

desktop.update.status.description: Read a registered desktop installation's public update status.

discovery.list.description: LAN discovery status on the current network and up to 100 pacer machines seen there, most recent first. Names and versions are unverified. warning is set when the state file could not be read and discovery failed closed. network.name is the machine name this machine advertises.

discovery.network.get.description: Per-network advertising answers, with networksRev (the revision discovery.network.set expects) and the current network's key.

discovery.network.set.description: Allow or stop advertising this machine on a network, mute its prompts, or reset its discovery id. expect_rev is networksRev from discovery.list or discovery.network.get; LAN traffic does not change it.

discovery.respond.description: Answer a found-machine prompt: pair (hands over to a pairing plugin if one is installed; a hand-over closes the prompt), later (silence for 7 days), ignore (permanently) or mute-network (no more prompts on that machine's network).

discovery.set.description: Turn LAN discovery (listening and advertising) on or off on this machine. Off closes the open prompts. It is machine-local state, not strategy, so it works before setup. expect_rev is networksRev from discovery.list or discovery.network.get.

dispatch.analytics.description: Comparable reviewed outcomes, sample sizes and uncertainty; missing usage stays unknown.

dispatch.answer.description: Answer a managed executor question and resume the same work item.

dispatch.child.description: Delegate a scoped child work item using the current attempt's grant and an idempotency key.

dispatch.config.get.description: Read the active planner and effective dispatcher configuration, including built-in defaults.

dispatch.dependencies.description: Set same-root dependencies with a revision check.

dispatch.dependencies.waive.description: Waive a dependency with an audit reason and revision check.

dispatch.enforcement.description: Read native subagent control certification and exclusion reasons for a repository.

dispatch.enforcement.consent.description: Grant or decline consent for scheduled certification probes on an account. Probes spend the account's own quota to certify its enforcement guard.

dispatch.enforcement.denied.description: Record a native child denial for the authenticated strict attempt.

dispatch.enforcement.probe.description: Start a quota-using native subagent control canary for one local executor and repository.

dispatch.events.description: Scoped work timeline after a monotonic cursor.

dispatch.explain.description: Explain, read-only, which executor a request would go to: task.delegate ranking (via: delegate, the default) or dispatch.submit/child ladder (via: dispatch), the reasons, the fallbacks and the planner's cost. Starts, reserves and writes nothing.

dispatch.learning.reset.description: Reset derived learning for a repository without deleting work history, and optionally exclude it.

dispatch.list.description: Page through work roots or children, optionally filtered by repository and state.

dispatch.models.description: Declared model inventory and observed suggestions with authorization status.

dispatch.preview.description: Preview account/model dispatch using cached observations and the replaceable decision engine. Does not reserve capacity or launch work.

dispatch.refresh.description: Refresh scoped model/capability/usage/health observations with backoff.

dispatch.retry.description: Retry a settled managed work item in the same lineage and worktree with a new attempt.

dispatch.review.description: Review a child work item after its required children are accepted.

dispatch.stop.description: Stop a work subtree at the expected revision.

dispatch.submit.description: Submit a root work item to the dispatcher.

dispatch.tree.description: Scoped nested work tree, selected decisions, dependencies and aggregate execution time.

dispatch.wait.description: Wait for a work item to settle.

doctor.run.description: Run setup, service, account and integration diagnostics with fixed isolated Claude handler probes. Configuration and tested handlers do not prove host invocation. No repairs are performed.

executor.setup.candidates.description: OpenCode providers, local model servers and catalog providers that can become executors; no secrets.

executor.setup.connect.description: Connect a catalog provider through OpenCode, which stores the key (never pacer). This release runs nothing and returns the opencode auth login command to run in a terminal; an optional key is accepted for later releases and never used or stored.

executor.setup.models.description: Usable models for one setup candidate, with a recommended pick and usage type.

files.search.description: Search file paths, read-only, in registered repositories for the command menu: tracked files only, bounded, with matched ranges and the running tasks that changed each file. Writes nothing.

host.account.add.description: Map a host account folder and return its login command.

host.add.description: Add an SSH host alias without connecting to it.

host.check.description: Check SSH host prerequisites, checkouts and identity.

host.clean.description: Preview host branch fates or clean worktrees as a job.

host.get.description: Host facts, checks, capacity and recent work.

host.list.description: Configured SSH hosts and running task counts.

host.remove.description: Remove an SSH host unless a runner uses it; local is reserved.

host.repo.map.description: Map a canonical repo key to a host checkout.

host.repo.setup.description: Clone and set repo identity with explicit consent, as a job.

host.set.description: Set host capacity, pause new work, or choose recording-only or full live sessions.

host.suggest.description: SSH aliases not already configured as hosts.

host.terminal.description: Open an SSH terminal for a host.

insights.summary.description: Where the work and tokens went in a period: distinct root tasks and child tasks reached by attempts ended in the period (the union across agent rows, not their sum), token totals with coverage, the spread per agent, a series per bucket, task kinds by agent, ladder rules and skip reasons, plus the previous period for comparison. Acceptance and retry counts retain the first-settle cohort.

issue.import.description: Read one GitHub issue (title, body, labels, URL, state) of a registered repository through the user's gh login, as capped plain text for a new task. The GitHub repository comes from the checkout's origin remote. Writes nothing.

issue.search.description: Search a registered repository's GitHub issues for a picker (number, title, labels, URL, state) through the user's gh login. Writes nothing.

job.cancel.description: Cancel a job that supports cancellation.

job.list.description: List retained shared jobs, optionally for a target.

limits.check.description: Provider limits, freshness and usage sources.

limits.refresh.description: Refresh configured account usage from each provider's available source without starting an agent turn.

limits.report.description: Mark a provider's account exhausted until unix seconds or its cooldown.

machine.get.description: This machine's identity: id, name, revision and whether the home looks copied. After a rotation it adds rotatedFrom (the previous id) and rotationSignature (the old key's signed rotation statement, base64).

machine.rotate.description: Replace this machine's key and id. Paired machines must be told or pair again. An unavailable error with data.rotationPending true (and data.oldId, data.newId) means the new key is already in place but finishing the rotation failed; it completes the next time pacer loads the machine identity.

machine.set.description: Rename this machine against the expected revision. Names are display-only.

mode.hold.description: Hold a mode until a timestamp or the planner window resets.

mode.release.description: Release the held mode and return to pace-derived mode.

msg.close.description: Close a task for further messages and release its worktree when it is otherwise cleanable. Records no review verdict.

msg.confirm.description: Release a message that a guardrail held for human confirmation.

msg.policy.description: The effective messaging guardrail, or which rule decides a hypothetical send.

msg.send.description: Send a message to another participant. A message to a settled task starts a turn that resumes its native session once project policy admits it (delegate, then route); another admitted executor replays the thread when policy excludes the prior one. A veto or no admitted executor returns delivery held with hold { reason, plugin? }, and the message stays pending.

msg.wait.description: Block until a message for the caller arrives, or a reply to reply_to, or timeout_s passes (max 3000).

notifications.set.description: Set notifications to off, important or all.

onboarding.skip.description: Skip the first delegation and record the onboarding choice.

onboarding.try.description: Start a tiny docs delegation in a scratch git repository; returns task_id, executor and repo.

plugin.disable.description: Stop a plugin and record it as disabled.

plugin.doctor.description: Start enabled plugins if idle and ping each with a 5 s deadline; report protocol versions, served extension points, restarts and errors.

plugin.enable.description: Enable a plugin. An installed plugin without a matching grant returns needs_grant with its capability set until called with grant: true.

plugin.install.description: Retired: pacer no longer ships an Orca plugin. Always fails with not_allowed; removed in the next protocol major.

plugin.list.description: Discovered plugins with state, capabilities, grants and pid; starts nothing.

plugin.remove.description: Disable an installed plugin, delete its folder and forget its grant. Bundled plugins return not_allowed.

plugin.settings.get.description: A plugin's settings schema (from its manifest), saved values and revision.

plugin.settings.set.description: Validate and save a plugin's settings against its manifest schema. A stale expect_rev returns conflict; invalid values return invalid_input with field errors in data.

plugin.ui.action.description: Send a user action on a plugin surface to the plugin. requestId makes a repeat safe.

plugin.ui.list.description: Every UI surface of every enabled, granted plugin: activity items, panel tabs, settings pages and status items, with visibility. Starts nothing.

plugin.ui.render.description: Render one plugin surface to a validated view document. Starts the plugin if idle, except for status items, which render only while the plugin is ready.

plugin.ui.visibility.description: Show or hide one plugin surface. Service state, so every client agrees. A stale expect_rev returns conflict.

project.messaging.get.description: Read a repository messaging policy and revision.

project.messaging.remove.description: Remove repository messaging rules with a revision check.

project.messaging.set.description: Set repository messaging rules with a revision check.

project.strategy.get.description: Read a repository executor override and revision; null executors inherit global routing.

project.strategy.list.description: List repository executor overrides, including policies for absent checkouts.

project.strategy.remove.description: Remove a repository override and restore global routing, preserving its revision.

project.strategy.set.description: Set an ordered repository executor allowlist. Requires the current revision (0 for a new policy).

repo.list.description: Registered repos with local branches, current first.

repo.remove.description: Remove a repository from the registry.

routing.get.description: Routing rules and available executor ids.

routing.route.description: Rank confirmed eligible executors before labelled uncertain fallbacks for an optional task kind.

routing.set.description: Validate and replace routing rules, keeping the default last and preserving comments.

runner.add.description: Add an agent/account runner to the default routing rule.

runner.block.description: Block an executor for a duration, with an optional reason.

runner.check.description: Check executor CLI, sign-in, usage and a scratch test task.

runner.remove.description: Remove a runner and its routing and pacing order references.

runner.set.description: Edit an executor's settings and rank.

runner.settings.get.description: Read editable executor settings and an opaque revision.

runner.settings.save.description: Atomically save executor order, enabled states and parallel limits against the expected revision.

service.handover.description: After an upgrade, ask older runners to hand their live attempts to this service's version. Waits up to wait_s seconds (default and maximum 60) and returns counts. Owner-only; refused for delegated callers.

service.install.description: Run pacer in the background at login to keep budgets fresh and run delegated tasks, after explicit consent.

service.status.description: Whether the login service is installed and running, with its process id when known.

service.work.description: Running tasks and live sessions with their runner and host versions, and the sessions that need Reopen to update. Versions and counts only, never paths.

session.agent.create.description: Start an idempotent independent interactive agent in an existing task workspace, without creating another task.

session.agent.end.description: End only the selected agent session, retaining its output and workspace.

session.agent.get.description: Read one task-owned interactive agent session and its current attempt.

session.agent.list.description: List independently controlled interactive agents belonging to tasks.

session.agent.resume.description: Resume the selected native conversation with its original executor and account.

session.agent.retry.description: Start a fresh native conversation for an ended agent session, retaining earlier attempts.

session.attachment.prepare.description: Claim a later attachment and prepare explicit delivery without submitting agent input.

session.context.description: Private attachment draft and metadata for a conversation.

session.create.description: Start an idempotent persistent conversation in an explicit workspace.

session.draft.create.description: Create a private attachment draft, expiring after 24 hours if unclaimed.

session.end.description: End a conversation while retaining its workspace and output.

session.file.read.description: Read a bounded UTF-8 file inside one local session attempt's workspace.

session.prepare.description: Interactive executor capabilities and explicit workspace choices.

session.resume.description: Explicitly resume the native conversation with the same agent and account.

setup.check.description: Read the setup checklist and outstanding steps.

setup.health.description: Run the startup Checking setup gate: bounded doctor and setup checks as fixed steps, persist a last-pass fingerprint, and say whether the full-window stage can skip. Removable-volume probes stay out of the gate. trigger update forces the stage after an update.

setup.init.description: Create a missing strategy and select a planner without connecting agents.

snapshot.get.description: Read the complete current v3 snapshot, counts, attention and activity, with its event sequence.

strategy.list.description: Available strategies and the active strategy.

strategy.preview.description: Validate a strategy draft without writing and compare its ranking and routing.

strategy.remove.description: Remove a named strategy; default and the active strategy are protected.

strategy.save.description: Save a validated named strategy with a reason, optionally replacing an inactive strategy.

strategy.show.description: Show a strategy's YAML, summary and active status.

task.answer.description: Answer an executor question. A local task with a resumable session continues in that session after project policy admission; otherwise, or when policy holds it, a retry on the same executor. Conflicts unless awaiting input.

task.ask.description: Record one question from the current executor, then stop.

task.attach.description: Open a task viewer, or return a command when unavailable.

task.delegate.description: Hand a brief to an executor chosen by budget and priority (or `executor`).

title.description: Short task title (trimmed, 1–60 characters), stored separately from the full goal. Omitted titles are derived from the first goal clause with paths, URLs and backticked code removed and word-boundary truncation with an ellipsis. Snapshot tasks, task events, task.get, task.list, attention titles and activity text expose this title; older tasks derive it on read.

task.diff.description: Tracked changes against the task's base, plus untracked filenames.

task.dismiss.description: Hide settled tasks; unknown ids are reported.

task.list.description: Recent tasks, newest first, always returned as a cursor page.

task.log.description: Read up to 256 KiB per output stream from byte offsets. Returns an opaque source identity; reset offsets when it changes.

task.prune.description: Archive old reviewed or dismissed settled tasks; dry_run reports files and bytes without moving them.

task.request_review.description: Request a human decision on a completed result without accepting it.

task.restore.description: Restore an archived task and its artifacts; conflicting files are never overwritten.

task.retry.description: Re-delegate a task's stored brief (one active retry per task).

task.retry_all.description: Retry stored briefs, reporting skipped tasks individually.

task.retry_options.description: Executors available for retry in routing order.

task.review.description: Record the planner's verdict on a task.

task.send.description: Deliver one message into an interactive lane's live worker, through any backend that keeps one. Does not create a new attempt. A lane waiting on its question: conflict (answer it instead). Without a live worker whose terminal reports the lane's agent: unavailable; while another client holds the 60-second driving lease: conflict unless force.

task.session.description: Session host, capabilities and available viewers.

task.stop.description: Stop a task and its executor.

task.takeover.description: Stop a local headless run and resume its conversation interactively.

task.wait.description: Block until the task settles or timeout_s passes.

terminal.close.description: Stop and close a terminal tab when its revision still matches.

terminal.create.description: Open an idempotent interactive shell terminal in a local folder.

terminal.list.description: List the local user's built-in terminal tabs and their live or exited state.

terminal.rename.description: Rename a terminal tab when its revision still matches.

tree.status.description: Turn state of every node in a task's tree.

update.apply.description: Apply pacer update as a shared job; package-manager and source installs are refused.

update.check.description: Check the release version, optionally bypassing the cached update check. `plugin` is always null since the Orca plugin was removed.

account.models.description: Discover endpoint models using a supplied or stored key.
